2737.title: Background branch refresh can invoke SSH askpass
2737.rootCauseOneLine: The background branch refresh starts an interactive remote fetch with inherited SSH askpass settings.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff separates background and blocking fetch interaction and allows an explicit retry.

2737.proposedFix: Make background remote fetches non-interactive, keep explicit refreshes interactive, and permit an explicit retry after a background failure.
2737.caveats: The test verified askpass helper execution. It did not open or record a graphical system dialog.
